name: Standard Volume Shader Implementation
definition: Internally a close relative of Random Walk Subsurface Scattering. It applies the same thinking to a heterogeneous medium whose density varies at every voxel. Subsurface Color corresponds to Volume’s Scatter Color, Subsurface Radius corresponds to Transparency Color, and Subsurface Scale corresponds to Volume’s Depth.
summary: The Standard Volume Shader renders non-homogeneous media like smoke using GPU-stored voxel grids and a random-walk light transport model, distinguishing itself from subsurface scattering by handling density variations at every voxel.
